maincpu_irq2_ack_correlation.interpretation: The 30 ADSP DM($2006) writes and 30 main-CPU IRQ 2 entries have matching counts in both bounded traces. Every IRQ 2 entry runs the 68010 handler at 0x0213fe, clears 0x818060 at 0x021402, performs the handler body, and returns with RTE at 0x021418. Together with the MAME wiring, this resolves the ADSP-GINT -> main-CPU IRQ2 -> 68010 acknowledgement edge for the observed title path.
